lines.zh: 然后我收拾好第二天的书包。

On that day, I always eat birthday noodles with eggs.
lines.zh: 那天我总是吃加鸡蛋的长寿面。

lines.t: Long noodles are a symbol of long life.
lines.zh: 长长的面条象征着长寿。

lines.t: Every year, my family and I take a photo together under the big tree in our village.
lines.zh: 每年，我和家人都会在村里的大树下一起拍张照。

lines.t: I like taking photos because they help me remember fun times with my family.
lines.zh: 我喜欢拍照，因为照片能帮我记住和家人在一起的快乐时光。

lines.t: This year, I want to plant a small tree for my 14th birthday.
lines.zh: 今年，我想为我的14岁生日种一棵小树。

lines.t: I'd like to watch it grow with me.
lines.zh: 我想看着它和我一起长大。

lines.t: It's a great idea to plant a tree for your birthday!
lines.zh: 过生日种一棵树真是个好主意！

lines.t: I usually have a party with my friends to celebrate.
lines.zh: 我通常和朋友们开派对来庆祝。

lines.t: My mother always makes my favourite chocolate cake.
lines.zh: 我妈妈总会做我最爱的巧克力蛋糕。
大家一起唱《生日快乐》歌，

lines.t: and then I make a wish and blow out the candles.
lines.zh: 然后我许个愿，吹灭蜡烛。

lines.t: Next, we enjoy the cake, and I open all my gifts.
lines.zh: 接着我们吃蛋糕，我拆开所有礼物。

lines.t: My father marks my height on the door every year.
lines.zh: 我爸爸每年都在门上标出我的身高。

lines.t: It's fun to look at the marks later.
lines.zh: 以后再看这些记号很有意思。

lines.t: Next time, I also want to do something different.
lines.zh: 下次我也想做点不一样的事。
